node.statement: Corrected domain conclusion using only validated premises and the replacement child: for X_*=U^dagger, validated 1.2.2 gives ||(X_*)^dagger bold-dot X_*-J||=||U bold-dot U^dagger-J||<=2*epsilon_r, and X_* bold-dot U=U^dagger bold-dot U=J gives a right inverse. The preceding replacement child gives X_p=U bold-dot V a right inverse and defect at most 3*epsilon_r. Validated 1.1 gives rho>5*epsilon_r and calU_rho subseteq S_delta. Hence both defects are strictly below 2*rho (also when epsilon_r=0, since then they vanish and rho>0), so def-approximate-unitary-space places X_* and X_p in calU_rho and therefore in S_delta, where the single typed inverse pair fixed by 1.1 is defined. No use is made of pending node 1.2.3.
